tools.name: fiscalo_connection_test
tools.description: Check that the API key works and show its environment (sandbox or production). Use this first. Fiscalo API: GET /connection-test.

tools.name: fiscalo_list_customers
tools.description: List customers of the company behind the API key. Filter by name, tax number or your own external_id. Fiscalo API: GET /customers.

tools.name: fiscalo_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer by its Fiscalo id. Fiscalo API: GET /customers/{id}.

tools.name: fiscalo_create_customer
tools.description: Create a customer (individual or company). Writes need production access on the company. Fiscalo API: POST /customers.

tools.name: fiscalo_list_items
tools.description: List products and services in the catalog. Fiscalo API: GET /items.

tools.name: fiscalo_get_item
tools.description: Get one product or service by its Fiscalo id. Fiscalo API: GET /items/{id}.

tools.name: fiscalo_create_item
tools.description: Create a product or service with its unit price and tax rate. Writes need production access on the company. Fiscalo API: POST /items.

tools.name: fiscalo_list_tax_rates
tools.description: List the global tax-rate catalog (read-only). Use it to find the tax_rate_id for an item or a document line. Fiscalo API: GET /tax-rates.

tools.name: fiscalo_list_document_series
tools.description: List the document series of the company. A draft needs an active series (series_id). Fiscalo API: GET /document-series.

tools.name: fiscalo_list_documents
tools.description: List documents (invoices, credit notes, quotes and others) with their status. Fiscalo API: GET /documents.

tools.name: fiscalo_get_document
tools.description: Get one document with its lines, taxes, totals and status (draft or issued). Fiscalo API: GET /documents/{id}.

tools.name: fiscalo_create_document_draft
tools.description: Create a draft document for a customer in an active series. The draft is NOT issued: this tool cannot issue or cancel a document. Repeating the same call sends the same Idempotency-Key, so it does not create a second draft. Fiscalo API: POST /documents.

tools.name: fiscalo_add_document_line
tools.description: Add a line to a draft document. Only drafts accept lines; issued documents return document_not_editable. A retry adds the line again: check the document first. Fiscalo API: POST /documents/{id}/lines.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: fiscalo_add_document_line · Private data: fiscalo_connection_test, fiscalo_list_customers, fiscalo_list_tax_rates, fiscalo_list_document_series, fiscalo_list_documents, fiscalo_get_document, fiscalo_create_document_draft, fiscalo_add_document_line · Public sink: fiscalo_create_customer, fiscalo_create_item, fiscalo_create_document_draft, fiscalo_add_document_line.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: fiscalo_add_document_line · Private data: fiscalo_connection_test, fiscalo_list_customers, fiscalo_list_tax_rates, fiscalo_list_document_series, fiscalo_list_documents, fiscalo_get_document, fiscalo_create_document_draft, fiscalo_add_document_line · Public sink: fiscalo_create_customer, fiscalo_create_item, fiscalo_create_document_draft, fiscalo_add_document_line

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
